content:
alan: quick heads up — p95 spike on the latency dashboard for /v2/generate after the rollout at 11:05.

maria: which view? endpoint breakdown or merged route view?
alan: endpoint breakdown. p50 looks fine, p95 up ~30–40ms for one route.

jun: did rollout change route tags or add fallback routing? :eyes:
sre-bot: deploy redwood/serve v2.14.1 to prod completed at 2025-03-15T11:03Z

alan: query I ran:
```
SELECT pctl(95, latency_ms) FROM metrics WHERE path='/v2/generate' GROUP BY endpoint, route_label
```

maria: hmm we recently changed bucket boundaries in telemetry to 10ms bins -> might affect percentile approximation.
jun: right — histogram-based pctl will be sensitive to bin edges. Are we using tdigest anywhere for the dashboard? 
product-ux: I'm hearing we need clearer wording in the console: 'per-route' vs 'merged' and show sample counts. Current labels are confusing.

leo: checking ingestion — we added a route-weight rewrite for quota routing on 3/15; requests may now be double-counted when fallback applies.
alan: double-counted how? examples?
leo: primary route gets tagged, fallback gets same endpoint tag but different route_label; merge agg sums them and we show percentiles on merged stream — that can move p95.
maria: so either switch to unique request ids dedupe at ingestion or change dashboard to compute percentiles per request (not per tag).
jun: dedupe is heavy. alternative: dashboard should offer 'rollout-aware merge' that first chooses canonical route per request_id when available.

product-ux: proposal: add toggle 'rollout merge mode: treat fallback as separate / dedupe by request-id / show split view' and surface sample count and 95th percentile CI.
alan: agreed. Also add a footnote explaining histogram approximation and bin size impact.
maria: I'll draft the UI copy. jun — can you prototype flux to compute p95 with tdigest at query-time?
jun: will try, but tdigest on large rollups needs pre-aggregated sketches; we have sketches in the vector store already.
leo: action items: jun check tdigest feasibility by EOD; maria PR UX text; alan open dashboard bug for misleading label; I'll instrument ingestion to add request_id if not present.

alan: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
product-ux: adding to roadmap board :white_check_mark:
